No head-to-head rival exists (nothing else stores GeoJSON in SQLite from a JSON query document); MongoDB and DuckDB-wasm are positioned on the suite page

headlines.label: Long horizon
headlines.rival: the same run without a ledger
headlines.note: agent context retention, not speed: at a 6000-character history budget on the realistic payload shape, built-in compaction still carries 7 of 40 record values, and a ledger brings 40 of 40 back — verbatim or one recall away. The pairwise relation is 0% either way; only an environment moves it — see the suite page

headlines.label: Retrieval
headlines.note: retrieval mechanics, not speed: over 10,000 synthetic memories, the default recall (tag match, then recency) puts a gold memory in the top 10 for 1.3% of questions; the seam-gated ranked path (near, through the deterministic hash-trigram-64 embedder — lexical, a mechanism score) 5.0%, ahead of it; recency alone 0.0%, a random draw 0.0%. Embedding quality belongs to a real model behind the same seam; see the suite page

headlines.label: Vector
headlines.note: k-nearest over a derive: 'vector' column at 50,000 × 768: every path answers the identical top-k before a timing prints. The plan is 15.59× the same query with no column and 6.75× the resident sweep with no database at all; the column costs 2.09× the write. sqlite-vec answers 5.52× faster out of a database 6.59× smaller that holds no documents — see the suite page

headlines.label: Series
headlines.rival: no library rival — the routes a consumer already has
headlines.note: The temporal ground at 100,000 samples, measured before a kernel existed and re-measured against every route since. A sorted cut answers a one-hour range 58.17× a full filter, and a declared epoch column under an index answers it 56.87× the same range read back out of the stored JSON with date functions. A bucket ladder pushed into a stored GROUP BY is 1.75× the generic query route; a rolling window is a named refinement instead, costing 17.72× the kernel over an array already in memory. The durable range costs 334.57× the resident cut, which is the price of never having read the rest of the corpus — see the suite page
